typescript-symbols.summary: Find declarations in a JavaScript or TypeScript file.
typescript-symbols.guidance: Pass a source file and optionally a top-level function and a name filter. Use --filter in place of the function to filter the whole file. For namespace members, filter by qualified name, such as Outer.Inner.Entry. Read the relevant lines before editing.

python-symbols.summary: Find Python declarations without importing the source.
python-symbols.guidance: Use the reported spans to select which lines to read. The parser works offline.

powershell-symbols.summary: Find PowerShell declarations without running the source.
powershell-symbols.guidance: The filter matches functions, types, and class members. Read the relevant lines before editing.

model-fit.summary: Estimate memory fit for one or more computers.
model-fit.guidance: Use free or usable RAM in GiB for each computer. Runtime overhead is reserved per device. The estimate requires no model runner.
